title: UMD Libraries space availability
description: Current bookable-space availability for one UMD library location. Additional properties are LibCal space-group ids as string keys; overall_available and total are location-wide aggregates. Derived from a live probe — the upstream OpenAPI declares an untyped 200 body.

overall_available.description: Spaces available right now across every group at this location.

total.description: Total bookable spaces at this location.

available.description: Spaces free right now. Serialised as a string by the upstream service.

total.description: Spaces in this group. Serialised as a string by the upstream service.

next_available.description: ISO 8601 local start time of the next free slot, or null when none is known.
